# The Epidemiologist R Handbook

> A free R reference guide for applied epidemiology and public health. Task-centered code you can use online or offline.

Published by [Applied Epi](https://appliedepi.org/).

Applied Epi is a nonprofit organisation created by and for applied epidemiologists. Our 80 team members are R experts with experience fighting outbreaks and building public health data systems. Over 1 million people use our free resources, and over 500 agencies choose Applied Epi to train and support their staff.

Our [Introduction to R for Applied Epidemiology](https://appliedepi.org/training/training.html) course is trusted by the US CDC, the WHO, and 500+ other health agencies and Field Epidemiology Training Programs worldwide.

Be notified of new materials, courses, and scholarship opportunities via [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/appliedepi/) or our [email list](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdtk7Mg32lYQ3ucbIM-kIwIRxgRwDfG5TJHsVAbFjQ1i6fwiw/viewform).

Contact: [appliedepi.org](https://appliedepi.org/) · [contact@appliedepi.org](mailto:contact@appliedepi.org)

## What Applied Epi offers

- [Free tutorials and case studies](https://appliedepi.org/resources/resources.html): Get started with our free interactive tutorials or practice skills with our case studies.
- [Live R training](https://appliedepi.org/training/training.html): Join a live course with 1-to-1 tutoring from experienced epidemiologists.
- [R workflow support](https://appliedepi.org/support/support.html): Get expert help with your R code, your analyses and your data systems through our Support Desk.
- [Community](https://community.appliedepi.org/): Join a global community of epidemiologists who share knowledge and answer each other's questions.
